critical_code_review_comments: WelcomeHero.tsx (643 lines) is over the 700-line soft cap only marginally, but the file already mixes 4 sub-components (useStagger, PulseDot, SpringIn, TypingDots) plus makeStyles. Consider extracting the animation helpers to /components/welcome/heroAnimations.ts and the value-card renderer to a small child component to keep the file <500 lines. Not a bug — tech-debt suggestion for maintainability.

All new content uses tx(key, fallback) with English fallbacks embedded in code (subtitleV2, value.*.title/copy, featurePill, mock.liveSession, mock.typing). This is safe because the adoption endpoint reported 100% adoption and no hardcoded regressions were detected — the tx() wrapper is recognised by the scanner. Fallbacks act as double insurance if a locale file loses a key.
Delta pill (+N since you landed) worked in practice: observed +5 badge on AI Sessions Today after the SSE snapshot updated — SpringIn spring animation renders cleanly.

useStagger currently disables useNativeDriver on web (correct); however the effect has an empty deps array with an eslint-disable. Acceptable since values ref is stable, but the comment could be replaced with an explicit lint suppression scoped to just the exhaustive-deps rule.
Feature pill graceful behavior verified: when featureCount is 0/undefined, it renders as just 'AI coaching tools live today' (no leading '0+'). Confirmed on live page.
